name: Preset: Seba / RethinkX disruption
description: Tony Seba's technology-disruption framework as scenario levers: cost curves at electronics-like learning rates, fleets built at the fastest historical ramps, high utilization (transport as a service), approvals accelerated where fleets already operate, embodiment clocks coupled tightly to the software frontier, and an eroding preference for human-made content. Reproduces the shape of his S-curve claims; the forecast scoreboard compares his 2017 and 2020 numbers with the model's.
